resources.string: The KOReader plugin will connect automatically when the server is running.

Rakuyomi Bridge needs access to manage all files on your device so it can read / write manga data in the shared KOReader folder at /storage/emulated/0/koreader/rakuyomi.\n\nYou will be taken to Settings. Tap the toggle to grant \"Allow access to manage all files\", then press Back.
Rakuyomi Bridge runs a foreground service to keep the server alive. Android requires notification permission so the service can stay active.\n\nTap Allow when prompted.
No logs yet. Server requests will appear here.
This directory is where Rakuyomi stores its database, sources, and downloaded chapters. It should ideally be the same folder used by the KOReader plugin.
Required to access folders outside of app-specific storage.
Rakuyomi is a manga reader plugin for KOReader. This app acts as a bridge to run the Rust server on Android.
Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, and Axum (Rust).
Notification for the rakuyomi background server
